stages.caption: The input, cropped to the area's bounding box and gridded so each pixel has one true ground size.
stages.headline: 0.46 m/px
stages.title: Source imagery

stages.caption: Each pixel's greenness from its colour alone (2g − r − b on chromatic coordinates). Yellow is greenest, purple least green. Pixels outside the area are dimmed.
stages.headline: p1–p99 0.0115 to 0.8261
stages.title: EXG vegetation index

stages.caption: Pixels above the threshold are green. Otsu's method picks the split that best separates the two populations of index values; the bimodality coefficient says whether there really are two.
stages.headline: otsu at 0.283
stages.title: Threshold

stages.caption: Opening then closing with a small disk removes speckle and fills pinholes; objects and holes under 1 m² go. Green is canopy, red is what the cleaning removed. Canopy area and cover come from this mask.
stages.headline: 20.8% canopy cover
stages.title: Cleaned canopy mask

stages.caption: Sunlit crowns are brightest and greenest in the middle. A Laplacian-of-Gaussian blob detector, run at every crown size from half the minimum diameter up to the maximum, finds one peak per crown even where crowns touch. White dots are the crown centres that fall on canopy; each seeds one watershed region.
stages.headline: 1183 crown centres
stages.title: Crown centres

stages.caption: Marker-controlled watershed floods outward from each crown centre over the smoothed blob response, inside the canopy mask and within 1.4 blob radii of the centre. Every colour is one region.
stages.headline: 1183 regions
stages.title: Crown segments

stages.caption: Regions are kept or rejected (grey) by size and solidity, then scored from explainable signals. Green is high, amber medium, red low confidence.
stages.headline: 1107 crowns, range 1032–1182
stages.title: Filtered and scored crowns

warnings: This imagery is 0.46 m per pixel. The AI tree detector was trained on 0.1 m imagery and is unreliable above 0.2 m, so classical blob detection was used instead (see the Pipeline tab).
76 regions were rejected by size or shape filters. Toggle the Rejected layer to see them.
75 crowns have low confidence; these are most often merged crowns in dense canopy.
23 crowns touch the area boundary; they are counted, but their areas are truncated.
Basemap imagery has no reliable acquisition date; the trees may have changed since capture.
